headline: Colonials Gain in Weathered Expanse; Wardens Retake Stonecradle Post
war_summary: Since the last edition the sharpest news is in Weathered Expanse and Stonecradle. Weathered Expanse, which stood six Warden posts to three Colonial, now reads five to four, and Crow's Nest and Frostmarch are the most-fought-over names on the 24-hour board, with base events recorded inside the past two hours. Stonecradle has closed its neutral gap: no strategic post now lies unclaimed, and the count stands six Colonial to three Warden. Mooring County saw a strongpoint change hands in the early watches, The Wind Hills coming into Colonial possession; the county remains eleven Warden to one Colonial. Linn Mercy is still wholly Colonial but continued to log base events around Lathair and Rotdust after the last edition, while Fishermans Row stays Colonial throughout and Gutter remains in Warden hands. Stlican Shelf is split five Warden posts to four Colonial, with Thornhold the pivot of repeated exchanges on the morning wire. Farranac Coast still carries two Warden posts against nine Colonial. Elsewhere the strategic-base wire is quiet; the heaviest casualty books of the past day belong to Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse, and War 140 passes day 329 with no winner declared.
